title: NPU Offloading of a Frozen Visual Encoder for Robot Policy Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.15002v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a robot policy is trained for a new task or dataset, its visual encoder can be frozen and only its action generation module trained, reducing training cost. Freezing removes the encoder's backward pass, but its forward pass must still run at every training step because the input images change, so it keeps consuming GPU compute. We therefore ask whether moving this computation to a low power AI accelerator such as an NPU can reduce total energy despite the added data transfer and longer training time, and how it affects policy performance. We built an asynchronous training pipeline that uses both a GPU and an NPU for the AR-Actor specialist. The frozen visual encoder runs in A8W8 INT8 on a Mobilint Aries2 NPU, while the FP32 action expert is trained on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU. We compared a GPU-only baseline with four conditions, L1 to L4, which gradually extend NPU offloading from one to four Transformer encoder layers.

translated_title: 冻结视觉编码器的NPU卸载用于机器人策略训练
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.15002v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：当为新的任务或数据集训练机器人策略时，其视觉编码器可以被冻结，仅训练动作生成模块，从而降低训练成本。冻结操作移除了编码器的反向传播，但其前向传播仍必须在每个训练步骤中运行，因为输入图像会变化，因此它持续消耗GPU计算资源。因此，我们探究将这一计算转移到低功耗AI加速器（如NPU）是否能在增加数据传输和延长训练时间的情况下减少总能耗，以及这对策略性能的影响。我们构建了一个异步训练流水线，同时使用GPU和NPU来处理AR-Actor专家模型。冻结的视觉编码器以A8W8 INT8格式在Mobilint Aries2 NPU上运行，而FP32动作专家则在NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU上训练。我们将仅使用GPU的基线方法与四个条件（L1至L4）进行了比较，这些条件逐步将NPU卸载从一层扩展到四层Transformer编码器层。
tldr: 本文提出一种异步训练流水线，将机器人策略训练中冻结的视觉编码器卸载到NPU，以降低总能耗，同时通过逐步扩展卸载层数评估其对策略性能的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an asynchronous training pipeline that offloads a frozen visual encoder to an NPU during robot policy training to reduce total energy, evaluating the impact on policy performance by gradually extending offloading across Transformer encoder layers.
